title: Translation Of Letters From The Procuratorate Of The Second Branch

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2865.
Date 3. 11. 31.

November 2nd, 1.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No.44 of October 30, regarding a female named Zau
(趙梅貞)
Mei Tseng,,who is wanted on a charge of opium
smuggling and to inform you that the matter is
receiving attention.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

T.N. Wong, Esq.,
Chief Procurator,
Second Branch Kiangsu High Court.

复者准
尊處十月日函字第四四号出為
请求協緝女犯趙梅貞一名因私販
鴉片一案在逃未獲等由准此刻已
飭屬一体注意偵緝矣相应函复
即希
查照为荷此致
江蘇高等法院第二分院
首席檢察官王
刑事處長安士

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号：S. B. D. 2865。
日期：31年11月3日。

11月2日，1。

先生：

兹收到阁下10月30日第44号来函，关于一名名为赵梅贞（Zau Mei Tseng）的女子，该人因涉嫌走私鸦片而被通缉，特此函复，此事正予以关注。

此致
敬礼

副总监（刑事）

王承文 先生，
首席检察官，
江苏高等法院第二分院。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
C. & S. B. D. 2865
Date 3. 11. 31.）

Translation of Letter from the Procuratorate of the Second Branch
Jiangsu High Court. October 30, 1931.

No. 2/44

Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Gentlemen,

I am in receipt of a communication from
the Jiangsu High Court requesting our assistance in
effecting the arrest of a female named Han Mei Zhen
(赵梅贞), who is wanted for failing to answer a
charge of opium smuggling preferred against her by
the aforesaid Court.

I enclose herewith a Circular Order of
Arrest and hope you will kindly have this circulated
among all districts concerned for information with a
view to bringing her to justice.

Wong Cheng Man
Chief Procurator.

（手写签名）

江苏高等法院第二分院检察处来信译文。1931年10月30日。

第 2/44 号

上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

诸位先生：

本处收到江苏高等法院来文，请求协助逮捕一名名为赵梅贞（Han Mei Zhen）的女子，该人因未就上述法院对其提起的走私鸦片指控出庭应讯而被通缉。

现随函附上逮捕通令一份，望贵处将其分发给所有相关辖区知悉，以便将其绳之以法。

王承文
首席检察官

（手写签名）

page_data.en:
CIRCULAR ORDER OF ARREST.
re Case No. 231/20

In connection with the above case, at the request
of our Procuratorate, a Circular Order of Arrest is
hereby issued in accordance with Articles 50 & 51 of
the Chinese Criminal Law Procedure against one female
named Hau Poi Tseng (趙梅貞), age 22 years, native of
Tsin-kiang (靖江), formerly residing at Si Po Moh Jao
(西柏木橋), Tsin-kiang, on a charge of being in
possession of opium for sale at her dwelling house in
Tsin-kiang in July 1931 (6th moon, 20th year), who
absconded, whilst case pending for appeal, and failed
to appear in answering the above charge. She is to be
brought before the Kiangsu High Court, if arrested.

Issued by Chief Judge Hau Tseng Tang
of the Kiangsu High Court
Dated 25.10.31.
page_data.zh:
逮捕通令。
关于案件编号 231/20

就上述案件而言，应本处检察官之请求，根据《中华民国刑事诉讼法》第50条及第51条规定，现对一名名为赵梅贞（Hau Poi Tseng）的女子发布逮捕通令。该女子22岁，籍贯靖江（Tsin-kiang），原住靖江西柏木桥（Si Po Moh Jao），被控于1931年7月（民国二十年农历六月）在其靖江住所内持有鸦片意图出售。该案在上诉待决期间，该女子潜逃，未能出庭应诉上述指控。如将其逮捕，应送交江苏高等法院。

由江苏高等法院首席法官侯增堂（Hau Tseng Tang）签发
日期：31年10月25日。
